name: lab706PatientList
description: Patient-list template for the MOH 240 laboratory register (A-AA). Joined onto lab706Base per person; every presentation field is derived here from the raw facts - names/addresses/identifiers/telephone as per-row correlated subqueries (safe on a paginated page), coded answers translated through etl.concept_value_map (cvt = the test concept, cvm = the result concept). amount_charged and receipt_number come from the billing module (amrs.cashier_bill_line_item links to the order directly via order_id; the charge is SUM(price * quantity) over the order's non-voided, non-cancelled line items, the receipt number from the newest such bill). prior_treatment, condition_of_specimen and signature have no standard-model source and stay NULL. Received/analysed/dispatched map to the fhir report created/changed/issued stamps. Alias names are the app contract - see moh-240.columns.ts.

expressionOptions.expression: DATE_FORMAT(fbc.test_datetime, '%d/%m/%Y')
(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = fbc.person_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.preferred = 1 ORDER BY pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM amrs.encounter e2 WHERE e2.patient_id = fbc.person_id AND e2.voided = 0 AND e2.encounter_datetime < fbc.test_datetime)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn.given_name, NULLIF(pn.middle_name, ''), pn.family_name) FROM amrs.person_name pn WHERE pn.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pn.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn.preferred DESC, pn.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)
TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, fbc.test_datetime)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(' / ', NULLIF(pa.state_province, ''), NULLIF(pa.county_district, '')) FROM amrs.person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa.preferred DESC, pa.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(pa.city_village, ''), NULLIF(pa.address3, '')) FROM amrs.person_address pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa.preferred DESC, pa.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT pa.value FROM amrs.person_attribute pa WHERE pa.person_id = fbc.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 AND pa.person_attribute_type_id IN (10, 48) ORDER BY pa.person_attribute_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(cvm_ed.name, CAST(ed.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_ed ON cvm_ed.concept_id = ed.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND ed.voided = 0)
NULL

(SELECT COALESCE(cvm_sp.name, CAST(o_sp.value_coded AS CHAR)) FROM amrs.obs o_sp LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_sp ON cvm_sp.concept_id = o_sp.value_coded WHERE o_sp.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_sp.concept_id = 10338 AND o_sp.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_sp.obs_datetime DESC, o_sp.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
NULL
COALESCE(cvt.name, CAST(fbc.concept_id AS CHAR))
DATE_FORMAT(fbc.test_datetime, '%d/%m/%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(fbc.report_date_created, '%d/%m/%Y')

COALESCE((SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', pn2.given_name, NULLIF(pn2.middle_name, ''), pn2.family_name) FROM amrs.encounter_provider ep JOIN amrs.provider pr ON pr.provider_id = ep.provider_id JOIN amrs.person_name pn2 ON pn2.person_id = pr.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 WHERE ep.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT COALESCE(cvm_cl.name, CAST(o_cl.value_coded AS CHAR)) FROM amrs.obs o_cl LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_cl ON cvm_cl.concept_id = o_cl.value_coded WHERE o_cl.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_cl.concept_id = 1496 AND o_cl.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_cl.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1))
DATE_FORMAT(fbc.report_date_changed, '%d/%m/%Y')
COALESCE(cvm.name, CAST(fbc.result_numeric AS CHAR), TRIM(fbc.result_text), DATE_FORMAT(fbc.result_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d'))
DATE_FORMAT(fbc.report_issued, '%d/%m/%Y')

(SELECT SUM(bli.price * bli.quantity) FROM amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b ON b.bill_id = bli.bill_id WHERE bli.order_id = fbc.order_id AND bli.voided = 0 AND b.voided = 0 AND bli.status <> 'CANCELLED')

(SELECT b.receipt_number FROM amrs.cashier_bill_line_item bli JOIN amrs.cashier_bill b ON b.bill_id = bli.bill_id WHERE bli.order_id = fbc.order_id AND bli.voided = 0 AND b.voided = 0 AND b.receipt_number IS NOT NULL AND bli.status <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY b.date_created DESC, bli.bill_line_item_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(cvm_rf.name, CAST(o_rf.value_coded AS CHAR), o_rf.value_text) SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.obs o_rf LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_rf ON cvm_rf.concept_id = o_rf.value_coded WHERE o_rf.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_rf.concept_id IN (1272, 1932, 9552) AND o_rf.voided = 0)

CONCAT_WS('; ', NULLIF((SELECT o_cm.value_text FROM amrs.obs o_cm WHERE o_cm.encounter_id = fbc.encounter_id AND o_cm.concept_id = 9467 AND o_cm.voided = 0 ORDER BY o_cm.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1), ''), NULLIF(fbc.instructions, ''))
NULL
